description: One-pass implementation of BO AI personal-policy administration plus authenticated Person self-service credential management for AI-associated optional/required API-key and OAuth credentials. Reuse canonical Connect atomic configuration and :people_auth gateway; derive ownership from session; preserve write-only secrets, revoke/remove semantics and session-bound OAuth. Excludes Person-aware Agent runtime resolution/invalidation. Action reuse: extend existing System AI credential configuration, Engine/NodeRouter actions and PeopleCredentials gateway; UI helpers remain local-only; no agent-tool exposure. Tests first: policy/global grant matrix, AI-only eligibility, permission and isolation, secret-free rendering, API key replace, OAuth, revoke/remove, callback failures. Mermaid: graph LR; B[Backend contracts] --> BO[BO policy UI]; B --> P[Person credentials UI]; BO --> V[Validation]; P --> V.

comments.text: Action reuse decision: extend existing System AIProviderCredentialConfiguration, Connect.Mutations/CredentialStatuses/PersonCredentials/OAuthAttempts, PeopleCredentials gateway, and NodeRouter :people_auth dispatch. No new Action or agent-tool exposure. Person eligibility is server-derived from AIProviderCredential.connect_credential_id; retained own slots stay cleanup-only after policy changes. New OAuth credentials must be saved first as required/no-global, then global OAuth callback atomically installs the grant and desired policy to avoid orphan/half-configured state.

Implementation complete pending human UX/UI approval. Added BO disabled/optional/required policy controls and validation, encrypted staged OAuth policy completion for new optional/disabled OAuth credentials, AI-only secret-free People credential eligibility, /people/credentials API-key/OAuth/revoke/remove flows, retained disabled-slot cleanup, and origin/source-validated OAuth popup messaging. Reused canonical System/Connect/PeopleAuth/NodeRouter boundaries; no new Action/tool. Validation: mix q passed; focused backend/BO/People/OAuth suites passed (4 properties, 334 tests); existing Chromium People + System Config E2E passed (83 tests). Full Playwright suite was attempted but exceeded the 850s execution timeout after 300+ passing tests; focused required areas passed. New feature E2E remains blocked on zaq-jrg.31 UX approval before zaq-jrg.32.

Refresh follow-up: extending the existing Connect refresh lease/Oban worker and existing AI backfill migration; no new Action or tool exposure. Approved direction: migrated legacy AI OAuth grants are deleted after canonical copy, and orphaned source Connect credentials are deleted (shared source credentials survive only if unrelated grants still reference them). No forward repair migration because this branch is pre-release/fresh-DB only. Refresh jobs become unique per grant, proactive scheduling skips active leases, and worker contention snoozes until lease expiry rather than failing.

Refresh fix validation: mix q passed; migration/preflight/canonical migration plus refresh worker/scheduler/concurrency/recovery suites passed (1 property, 61 tests). Review found only a pre-deployment queued-job dedup concern; no repair was added because the approved rollout is fresh DB/pre-release and new inserts are now unique per grant. Existing focused BO/People E2E remains valid because this follow-up changes backend migration/refresh behavior only.

Approved enhancement pass on existing working tree. Action reuse: not applicable — presentation-only changes; credential operations and dispatch boundaries remain unchanged. Extract existing BO feedback banner into a shared DesignSystem component, reuse in BOLayout and PersonLayout, replace People credential policy/status icons with labeled badges, and make absent credential action a secondary Add/Connect button. Add focused LiveView/component coverage and run mix q.

Implemented approved People credentials UI enhancements on top of the existing working tree: labeled policy/status table badges, secondary Add/Connect actions for absent API-key/OAuth credentials, and extracted DesignSystem.FeedbackBanner reused by BOLayout and PersonLayout. Updated Storybook and focused component/LiveView tests. Validation: targeted suite 50 tests, 0 failures; mix q passed on repeat; Storybook feedback/flash rendered successfully in browser. Existing E2E authoring remains unchanged; this correction is covered at component/LiveView level.

Follow-up badge color rule: Personal policy Required uses danger/red; credential Status uses danger/red only when status is absent and policy is required; all other policy and status badges use neutral/grey.

Human reported on 2026-09-21 that they checked the completed pages and approve everything. Implementation was already complete and validated; final credential-management E2E remains tracked in zaq-jrg.32.
